description: Find the date N days (or N business days) after or before a date, with its weekday and Japanese era date (wareki). unit "business" skips Saturdays, Sundays and Japanese national holidays; "weekdays" skips only weekends. Good for deadlines in Japan. N from 0 to 100,000.

lang.description: Language of the user. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese (affects the source link and notes). Default "en".

unit.description: "calendar" (default), "business" (Japan: skip weekends and national holidays) or "weekdays" (skip weekends only).

name: add_days
title: Add or Subtract Days
